_doc: Molecular facts physics cannot derive. The general loop checks each trigger every step; when it fires, it applies the effect (e.g. modifying an enzyme Vmax). THIS is how durian+beer works with zero engine code — add a row, done.
explanation: Durian sulfur compounds inhibit ALDH, slowing acetaldehyde clearance; acetaldehyde accumulates and irritates the mucosa.
NSAIDs impair the protective mucosal barrier, increasing acid irritation and ulcer risk.
H. pylori colonization weakens mucosal defense, raising gastritis/ulcer irritation susceptibility.
